works.title: Harlots of the Desert
works.subtitle: A Study of Repentance in Early Monastic Sources (Cistercian Studies 106)
works.author: Sister Benedicta Ward, SLG
works.blurb: Sister Benedicta's careful study and fresh translation of the desert lives of repentance, Pelagia, Maria the niece of Abraham, Thais, and most famously Mary of Egypt, read against the wider grammar of early monastic teaching on metanoia.
